scenarios.title: Golden headless continuity journey
scenarios.note: The canonical Deniz/Arin headless journey passed on disposable PostgreSQL with deterministic story rendering and real story/world/NPC persistence. Real provider rendering remains an L8 concern.

scenarios.title: Foreign household cannot load child profile
scenarios.note: Foreign household lookup returned no protected child record, then the owning household reloaded the same profile with unchanged ownership.

scenarios.title: Foreign household cannot read or mutate story session
scenarios.note: Story application transition functions do not accept actor household identity, so the scenario must execute at the production auth/route boundary rather than pretending a raw service call proves tenant isolation.

scenarios.title: NPC belief state never crosses household boundary
scenarios.note: A real hearsay belief persisted in Household A remained invisible when the same NPC/fact identity was queried in Household B after DB reload.

scenarios.title: Stale expectedVersion is rejected without persistence leak
scenarios.note: A stale advance attempt was rejected and DB reload proved version, current scene, visits, checkpoints and story events were unchanged.

scenarios.title: Completed session cannot advance without persistence leak
scenarios.note: A real completed session rejected a later advance and DB reload proved status, version, current scene, visits, checkpoints and story events did not change.

scenarios.title: Second active session for the same child and world is rejected without persistence leak
scenarios.note: Starts from one real active child/world session, attempts a second start, and verifies no second session, visit, checkpoint, event or idempotency ledger record is persisted.

scenarios.title: Duplicate session advance idempotency key produces one mutation
scenarios.note: Runs the same session advance twice with the same idempotency key and verifies exactly one version change, visit, checkpoint, event and session_advance ledger entry.

scenarios.title: NPC rumor propagation behavior
scenarios.note: Runtime evidence proved same-household autonomous rumor propagation, deterministic confidence decay and cross-household exclusion.

scenarios.title: Accepted NPC opportunity to StoryHook composition
Rumor StoryHook to generated story scene
limitations: provider caller is deterministic test double
does not prove persistence or advanceSession/reader wiring
real provider coverage belongs to L8

scenarios.title: Generated scene to persisted session and reader state
limitations: generation provider is outside this scenario; L4-HOOK-SCENE-001 covers generation and L8 covers real provider

scenarios.title: Event-derived persisted emotion to decision utility
blockedBy: no production event-to-emotion delta derivation was found
context layer currently exposes only InMemoryEmotionalStateAdapter for emotion state
directly passing a hand-built vector into DecisionContextBuilder would not prove the production boundary
scenarios.note: Bounded profile emotion persistence and downstream UtilityEvaluator emotion consumption both exist, but the production orchestration links required by PX-LUMI-04 are incomplete. See PX_LUMI_04_EMOTIONAL_CONSISTENCY_BLOCKER.md.

scenarios.title: Bounded world time progression and inactivity freeze
scenarios.note: Runtime evidence proves forward-only world time, relevance filtering, limited nine-day behavior and a ten-day zero-budget background simulation freeze.

scenarios.title: Story outcome commit durability and idempotency
limitations: proves durable commit record/world version/event/outbox and retry idempotency
does not by itself prove downstream NPC materialized state mutation; PX-LUMI-09-002 covers that

scenarios.title: Materialized indirect outcome propagation
limitations: requires a disposable PostgreSQL database whose name contains test or review
